summary_1line: Bharata rejects the throne offered by Vasishtha and vows to go to the forest to bring Rama back to rule Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Bharata stands in the royal assembly before sages and ministers, tearful and resolute as he refuses the throne meant for Rama.
The grand court of Ayodhya glows with sages in bright garments around Vasishtha while Bharata enters, likened to the full moon lighting the night.
Moved ministers and elders in the सभा wipe tears of joy as Bharata declares he will go to the forest to bring Rama back.
